_comment: Single source of truth for per-route SEO metadata (issue #80). Consumed at runtime by each page's SeoHead and at build time by scripts/prerender.js, so the raw HTML a non-JS crawler receives cannot drift from what React renders. JSON rather than a module so plain Node can read it without a build step. Blog posts are deliberately absent: they are CMS content and are handled by the Lambda@Edge share.html path.
